opening_message:
Ticket 1: Karen Sloan (employee ID E043) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E043.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Karen Sloan is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Admin access to Payroll is permitted because her role owns the system.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E043 is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors max at read (no admin, and write requires advanced training). Requested admin exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: HR (authoritative for employment status) records Karen Sloan (E043) as a full-time Payroll Specialist. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so per policy a full-time employee whose role owns the system may have admin. Requested admin equals the maximum, so grant admin. Note: Security's note conflicts on employment type (claims contractor), but employment type is determined by HR's database; HR's record supports admin.
